svg.title: Estrela Carioca
svg.desc: Estrela Carioca Futebol Clube (BR-2), Rio de Janeiro — Football Architect. Layered heraldic football crest featuring the Christ the Redeemer statue, Sugarloaf Mountain, a cable car, waves and a gold star. Official colors: #151515 and #D0A85A, with neutral #FFFFFF. Transparent 1024 × 1024 canvas; eleven independently organized vector layers.
